These audio assets are not relicensed under the application's MIT license.
The beta runner linearly resamples, level-scales and repeats the words with
pauses, adding deterministic background noise, to form the 5–60 second speech
inputs. Those generated adaptations retain CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution/terms;
they are transient test files, not shipped application media. They are spoken
digits, not a natural-conversation quality/intelligibility corpus.
